target_customer: Utilities and hyperscalers buying power and grid equipment
problem: Evaluating large volumes of vendor bids for power and equipment procurement is slow and manual.
business_model: B2B SaaS procurement intelligence platform (pricing not public)
product_category: AI procurement for energy and infrastructure

founders.name: Nooshin Behroyan
previous_startups: Paxon Energy (energy-infrastructure services, exited 2025 per YC page)
founders.background_notes: About two decades of utility infrastructure experience.

founders.name: Kenny Stone
previous_startups: PlanGrid (YC W12, acquired by Autodesk for $875M per YC page)

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM document analysis across thousands of bid pages with citations and scenario modeling; SOC 2 Type II compliance is a stated requirement.

defensibility.rationale: Retaining evaluator judgment and supplier outcomes could create data lock-in, but no customers or moat evidence yet.

market_need_then: Company cites anonymized cases (22 vendors and 19,800 pages in 9 minutes; 6-month sourcing cut to 7 days); unverified.
outcome_analysis: HillStar is in YC's Fall 2026 batch, so there is no outcome to analyze. Founders bring utility domain experience and a prior YC exit (PlanGrid), and the company reports anonymized customer results, but no funding, customers or competitors could be verified from public sources.
notes: Search found nothing on HillStar funding. All traction claims self-reported. Competition not researched beyond failed search.
